Invert one mask or combine two masks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TensorLogicalMask` |
| Search words | tensor, logical, mask, not, and, or |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **A** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Left zero-or-nonzero mask |
| **B** | Tensor | No | 1 | Optional right mask required by and/or |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Mask** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Zero-or-one logical mask matching the input shape |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logical | Operator | `op` | Choice | `not` | `not`, `and`, `or` | The run | Use not with A only; use and/or when B is connected. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: TensorLogicalMask is a tensor graph operation node; PipelineExecutor tensor operation execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a unary tensor mask or graph fan-in logical layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
